label: Town of Georgia
header: # Town of Georgia -- sweep decisions applied 2026-10-22; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Georgia, official election results page: 'Library Trustee - 1 year (Vote for 3) -- Ben Chiappinelli 555; Heather Dunsmore 432; Sarah Savich 392; Nicole Jamison 380; Deborah Mann 217.' Chiappinelli and Heather Dunsmore were elected March 3, 2026 (Savich's membership already stands).

Georgia Public Library, Trustee Meeting packet for March 18, 2026 (supplied by Walter 2026-10-22), item B: Special Meeting minutes, March 10, 2026 -- the reorganized board is Ben Chiappinelli (Chair), Sarah Savich (Vice Chair), Kollene Caspers (Secretary), Terry Cleveland (Treasurer) and Heather Dunsmore, all present and voting. Item A (minutes, February 18, 2026) shows Cleveland and Caspers as trustees before the election -- they are the continuing members. The library website roster the sweep relied on was stale (it still listed Mann, who lost, and a 'Harvey' who appears in no minutes). Heather Dunsmore's election also corrects the sweep, which seated Brian Dunsmore on the surname alone -- his library membership is removed in the same push; his other records stand.
